claim.value: The selected trial must cover several reconstructed late cases.
claim.scope: Case-coverage requirement for trial selection; neither an exact count nor demonstrated generalization is supplied.

provenance.rationale: P025 explicitly supplies the several-case coverage requirement for selecting a bounded trial.

signal_basis.value: A smaller configuration repeatedly reproduces lateness while specified further removals cease to reproduce it. This evidence concerns the selected case and need not explain the other late starts.
signal_basis.scope: Selected-case replay evidence motivating broader case coverage when choosing a trial.

provenance.rationale: These spans supply the reproducing-reduction pattern, its selected-case scope, and the explicit limitation on explaining other late starts.
No unresolved empirical relation is needed to warrant this prospective trial-selection requirement.

rationale: The claim is a procedural coverage requirement. Given evidence restricted to a selected failure, requiring the trial to cover several reconstructed late cases is warranted as a safeguard against relying exclusively on that case. It does not assert that the observed reduction already explains those cases or establishes generalization.
uncertainty: The signal does not establish that any particular trial meets the requirement, and the mapping supplies no exact case count.
